title: Pool of Radiance
build: version 1.0, eight D64 images (archive.org d64_Pool_of_Radiance_v1.0_1988_SSI_Disk_1_of_4_Side_A); BOOT prints "POOL OF RADIANCE, VERSION 1.0"

records.c: SPELLE00's first entry, called by load_and_cast: the spell's targets, by the low nibble of the record's fourth byte ($2B35). 0: the caster alone ($A4F4). $0F: one the caster aims at, or, when a square is chosen rather than a combatant, everyone within the high nibble plus 1 squares of it (spell_targets_at). 8 and up: everyone within (nibble AND 7) plus 1 squares of the square aimed at. 4 to 7: (nibble AND 3) plus 1 combatants picked one by one (1 when the computer chose the spell), kept at $2B2E and copied to $9801; a cancel after one or more picks keeps those. 1 to 3, used by no spell, and an aim cancelled before anything was picked: ABORTED (combat message 7) and $2B18 set, which tells spell_flight and the spell's routine there is no target. The list goes to $9800 (its count first) and into the target list ($A640) through into_targets.
0: the caster is the target and the list's one entry.
$0F: aim at one, or at a square for an area.
A square was chosen: the radius is the record's high nibble.
8 and up: an area round the square aimed at.
X = the radius plus 1 for spell_targets_at. The fireball comes in here with a radius of its own.
4 to 7: picks; 1 to 3 fail. The carry, set by the CMP, adds one to (nibble AND 3).
The computer picks one only.
Each pick, until the count is met or the aim is cancelled.
None picked: ABORTED.
The picks into the list at $9801.
ABORTED: $2B18 = 1 and an empty list.
The count, then into the target list.
aim_spell with a square allowed as well as a combatant ($2B51 = 1).

The caster aims the spell: the target ($A4F5) cleared, the cursor and the panel on, slot 7 kept. The player aims with AIM's lists and cursor (entered at $0F61 with the spell's range, spell_range); the computer through ai_aim. Returns carry set when a combatant (its square then in $2B54/$2B55) or a square ($2B54 positive) was chosen, carry clear when nothing was.

Carry set when the aim found a combatant, whose square becomes the point ($2B54/$2B55, from entry_square at $0DF9), or a square; carry clear otherwise. The square choice is switched off again ($2B51 = 0) and slot 7's file noted to come back.

The computer's aim. The spell's byte at $DC9F (spell_info): bit 3 set aims at the caster itself; the high nibble is a radius it checks. Otherwise up to eleven tries ($2B08 from 10 down): a target within range (ai_target); with a radius, everyone within it of the target (spell_targets_at) must be on the other side, or the try is wasted. Carry clear when every try failed.
Bit 3 of the spell's information: the caster aims at itself.
A try: a target in range.
Everyone within the radius of the target.
One of the caster's own side in the area spoils the try.
The next try; after the last, none.

Ends timed effect kind A on the target: the target loaded, its effect of that kind found (find_entry_x) and ended (end_effect), then IS CURED (message $22). Carry set when there was one, clear when not. Reduce, Cure Blindness, Remove Curse, Dispel Magic, Haste and Slow use it.

SPELLE00's second entry, called by load_and_cast after spell_targets: nothing when there was no target ($2B18). Otherwise sound 3, a pause and a missile from the caster to the point aimed at ($2B54/$2B55, missile picture 6, fly_missile from $6586), unless the point is the caster's own square, the target is the caster, or the spell picks its targets one by one (targeting 5 to 7). The line is kept (save_line) for the lightning bolt.
No missile for targeting 5 to 7, the spells that pick two or more.
BLESS: the targets in the area on the caster's side, less any with an enemy within 2 squares (side_filter, A = 0), then spell_area.
CURSE: the targets in the area on the other side (side_filter, A = 1), then spell_area. The enemies within 2 squares of a foe are not taken out: that test is made for BLESS only.

Keeps the area's targets on one side: A = 0 the caster's own ($A4E2), 1 the other. Each target of the other side is crossed off (drop_area_target). For spell 1, BLESS, one on the right side that has an enemy within 2 squares (enemies_seen, A = 2, from it as the combatant in hand) is crossed off too; the caster is the combatant in hand again after. $2B08 holds the side wanted. Haste and Slow use it too.
Only for BLESS (spell 1): those in melee are left out.

CURE LIGHT WOUNDS: the first target (target 0, $273A) heals a d8 ($2B00), up to its full hit points ($6B76), when its condition byte is one of the five in heal_conditions: OK, unconscious, dying, the animated dead (3) and $09. Its condition is not changed. Then the entry is stored and the record's message, IS HEALED (report through $29AE). Any other condition: nothing, and no message. The potions' healing (items 58 and 62) comes in at $A8F2.
The condition looked for in heal_conditions.
The healing, capped at the full hit points.
The conditions CURE LIGHT WOUNDS and the potions heal: $85 unconscious, $84 dying, $01 OK, $03 (condition 3, DEAD, which ANIMATE DEAD gives its zombies) and $09.
CAUSE LIGHT WOUNDS: a d8 of magic damage (dmg_kind 8) through spell_area, which makes the touch roll ($FF range).
spell_area keeping the damage in $2B00, its kind 8, magic.
BURNING HANDS: damage of the caster's level, no roll ($2B00 and $2B0E), its kind 9, which reports as fire.

CHARM PERSON: the timed effect's fourth byte ($2B09) is the caster's side byte ($6C0C) with 6 added in, low nibble, and bit 7 so the routine runs again when it ends; then person_filter with no lost turn ($A4FC = 0) and spell_area. The byte after LDA #$06 is a NOP.
ENLARGE: strength 18 ($2B2F) with the percentage enlarge_percent gives for the caster's level ($2B2E), through set_strength.

Raises the first target's strength to $2B2F and its percentage to $2B2E, unless it is already as strong: stronger, or at exactly 18 with a percentage as high, whatever the new strength, so item 59's 21 with percentage 0 leaves an 18 as it was. The old strength plus 100, or the old percentage at 18, goes in the effect's fourth byte ($2B09) with bit 7 set, for the effect's end to put back. A target with no free timed-effect entry (free_effect), or already enlarged (kind $0C) or strong (kind $26), is left as it was: the caster is loaded again and nothing is cast. Otherwise the strength index and the combat figures are worked out again, the character stored, and spell_area adds the effect. Enlarge, READ MAGIC's record and items 59 come here.
A free effect entry is needed before the change.
Already under Enlarge or a strength effect: no more.
ENLARGE's percentages by caster level, read from $A9B0 + level, so level 1 is the byte after this one (this is the JMP's high byte): 0, 1, 51, 76, 91, 100 for levels 1 to 6.
ENLARGE's percentages for caster levels 1 to 6 (enlarge_percent + level): 0, 1, 51, 76, 91 and 100, so 18 at level 1 and 18/00 at level 6.

REDUCE: the first target makes a saving throw (save_roll); when it fails, an ENLARGE on it ends (end_kind $0C, IS CURED). That is all: REDUCE never calls spell_area, so its own effect (kind 13, IS REDUCED) is never added in combat.
No change: the caster loaded again and back.

MAGIC MISSILE: one missile for each two levels, rounding up (the LSR's carry), each a d4 plus 1: the dice (roll_d4s), then the number of missiles added. Magic damage through magic_damage. Item 65 comes in at $A9D6 with A = 4: two missiles.
SHOCKING GRASP: a d8 plus the caster's level, its kind $0C, which reports as electricity.

SLEEP: a pool of 4d4 ($2B00), the roll also making the sleepers lose their turn ($A4FC). The targets are taken in the list's order, nearest the point first, and each is crossed off when its condition is 3 (the animated dead), it is asleep already (kind $35), its level ($6BA0) is 6 or more, or its cost (sleep_cost) is more than the pool has left; otherwise the cost comes out of the pool. Then spell_area. There is no saving throw (the record's is 0).
SLEEP's cost for levels 0 to 5: 1, 1, 2, 4, 6, 12.

HOLD PERSON (the cleric's): the saving throw is made harder by the number of targets, hold_cleric's byte ORed into the record's save byte ($2B36): 2 for one, 1 for two, none for three. Then person_filter, with a lost turn ($A4FC = 1), and spell_area.
The save's adjustment into bits 5-7 of the save byte.
$A4FC = A, then keeps the targets that are persons: type ($6BD7) 0, or type 1 when its size ($6B99, low nibble, halved) is 0. Every other target is crossed off. Then spell_area.
HOLD PERSON's save adjustments for one, two and three targets: $C0, $A0, $00.

SNAKE CHARM: the caster's hit points now ($6C19) are a pool, and also make the charmed lose their turn ($A4FC). Entries 0 to 63 are taken in order, any side, each the head of its monster; one of type $0E is added to the target list while the pool covers its hit points, which come out of the pool. The first that costs more ends the list. Then spell_area.
SPIRITUAL HAMMER: the effect's fourth byte is the caster's level with bit 7, for its end to run; then spell_area.
MIRROR IMAGE: a d4 images in the effect's fourth byte; then spell_area.

STINKING CLOUD: the targets are gathered again from the point, within 2 squares, with direction 1's arc ruled out ($0360 = 1, $0361 = 0, spell_targets_at at $2903). Each makes a saving throw: one that saves is nauseous (kind $1E) for 2 rounds; one that fails is helpless (kind $1F) for a d30 plus 20 rounds and loses its turn ($A4FC). The effect is added straight away (spell_effect with the save marked failed), without spell_area.
A save: nauseous, for 2.
A failed save: helpless, for 21 to 50.

ANIMATE DEAD: up to the caster's level of the dead, anywhere on the battlefield: each entry, 0 to 63, that is dead ($83), of type 0, of size 0 or 1 and the head of its monster gets back up (get_back_up) with condition 3. It joins the caster's side under the computer ($6C0C = $80 + side), its sweeps ($6B98) and $6BA4 cleared, its memorised spells wiped ($6B20-$6B70), $6BB8 made an NPC's: $B2 for a monster or NPC, a morale figure of 0, never hurt (COMBAT's hurt_check); for a party member the old byte ORed with $FE, a figure of 102 or 104, so on the party's side it runs at its first turn in every fight, its hit points full, and its remembered target forgotten ($A600). The sides are counted again and spell_area adds IS ANIMATED.
Only the dead (load_target leaves the condition in X).
The memorised spells wiped.
CURE BLINDNESS: ends the blindness (kind $21) on the target.

CAUSE DISEASE: the effect's fourth byte is the caster's level with bit 7; the time's base a d6 with bit 6 set, which spell_effect drops (it keeps the low six bits), and the record has no time per level, so the time is a d6; then spell_area.

DISPEL MAGIC: for each target, each kind of timed effect from 63 down to 1 that it holds (find_entry) is tried, unless the effect's fourth byte ($4B80) is $FF. The chance (dispel_chance) is against the level in that byte's low nibble, which for CHARM PERSON holds 6 or 7 (the side) and for MIRROR IMAGE the images left. One that goes ends (end_kind, IS CURED), then the record's IS AFFECTED (spell_landed). Kinds 64 and up are never tried.

The chance of dispelling an effect of level A: 50, plus 5 for each level the caster has over it, less 2 for each level under. The chance is written into the CMP at $AC33; a roll of 0 to 99 (random_to) below it dispels. Carry clear when it does.
The CMP's operand, written by dispel_chance.

PRAYER: one timed effect, kind $31, held by no combatant ($A4F5 = $FF): its fourth byte is the caster's level, with bit 6 set for side 1, its time the level, no message; added straight to the table (effect_on_target).
REMOVE CURSE: ends a BESTOW CURSE (kind $24) on the target. CURSE (kind 2) is not touched.

FIREBALL: the caster's level in d6 (roll_d6s). With a target, the multicolour register $D022 flashes through fireball_flash and sound 10 plays; outdoors ($49E6 = 0) the targets are gathered again within 3 squares of the point, indoors the record's 4 stand. Fire damage (kind 9) through spell_area; the targets save for half.
Outdoors the radius is 2 (3 squares), indoors the record's 3 (4).
FIREBALL's flash, the colours from the last: yellow, white, yellow, light red.
HASTE: haste_or_slow with the caster's side and kind $2A, SLOW, as the kind it cancels.

The area's targets on one side (side_filter, Y), at most as many as the caster's level, nearest the point first. One that holds the opposite kind ($2B04) has it ended (end_kind, IS CURED) and is crossed off; the rest go to spell_area.
Crossed-off entries do not count towards the level.
HOLD PERSON (the magic-user's): as the cleric's, with hold_mu's save adjustments: 3 for one target, 1 for two, none for three or four.
The magic-user's HOLD PERSON save adjustments for one to four targets: $E0, $A0, $00, $00.
SLOW: haste_or_slow with the other side and kind $27, HASTE, as the kind it cancels. The record's save byte is 0, so there is no saving throw.
Item power 57: the time's base a 5d4, the caster's level doubled (12 for an item), then HASTE.
Item power 58: a d4 plus 8 healed, through CURE LIGHT WOUNDS's healing.
Item power 59: the caster's level doubled; strength 21, percentage 0, through set_strength.
set_strength for strength X and percentage A.
Item power 60: 20 damage along a line 3 squares long, through the lightning bolt's code with no shortening on a rebound.
Item power 61: the time's base a 5d4; then spell_area (the record holds the paralysis, kind $34).
Item power 62: 2d4 plus 2 healed, through CURE LIGHT WOUNDS's healing.

Item power 63: the time's base a 2d10 with bit 6 set, which spell_effect drops (it keeps the low six bits); the caster's level doubled; then spell_area (the record's kind $47, IS INVISIBLE, on up to four picked).
Item power 64: a fireball cast at level 3, 5 or 7 (a d3, doubled, plus 1).
Item power 65: two magic missiles (MAGIC MISSILE with A = 4).

CURE DISEASE's combat record points here: the lightning bolt's code with the caster's full hit points ($6B76) as damage and a line of 10. The spell itself is CAMP ONLY, so a caster never reaches it; kind_breath in SPELLE01 (effect kind 88) casts it as a breath weapon, and no monster file gives that kind.

READ MAGIC's combat record points here: strength 18/00 (percentage 100) for the caster, through set_strength. The spell itself is CAMP ONLY, so a caster never reaches it; readying the gauntlets of ogre power (item kind 131, kind_item_spell in SPELLE01) casts it.
LIGHTNING BOLT: the caster's level in d6, then bolt_line with a length of 8 and a shortening of 4.

A bolt along the line spell_flight kept, from the caster through the point: length A ($2B27), shortening X ($2B29), electricity ($2AFF = $0C). From the point it steps square by square (square_at), one length each, listing each combatant met ($9800) and stopping at a wall (a figure with a height) or the map's edge. A missile flies to where it stopped (bolt_missile), sound 10, and everyone listed saves and takes the damage (save_roll, spell_damage). Then, once only ($2B04), when length is left: if it is less than the squares travelled it rebounds at once, otherwise the shortening comes off first; it comes back along the line towards the caster's square ($2B25/$2B26), which it can reach.
A leg: Y, the square to start from on the line.
One step; none left ends the leg.
Somebody on the square joins the list; an empty square with a height stops the bolt.
Off the map: no length left.
The leg's last square.
The list into the targets; each saves and takes its damage.
A rebound, once, when length is left.
The new line: from where it stopped back to the caster's square.
Square $2B28 of the line traced from $0348/$034A (trace_line, $C3 = $C4 = $80): across in $FB and A, down in $FC and X.
The bolt's picture: missile picture $0A in colour pair 3 flies along the line (s_6529, fly_missile at $6586), the line's ends kept round it.
